Name: Chained
Description: Three of one element in the move. It runs on one idea.
Notes: When = same_element. Needs = how many of one element it takes. A class that is all one element gets this every time - that is its perk, so keep the bonus small. An Element column reading None or left blank counts as no element at all

Name: All Of A Kind
Description: All four of one element. Nothing in the move is a compromise.
Notes: Stacks with Chained, so an all-one-element move is worth 2 in total

Name: Star Finish
Description: A Star Player takes the shot.
Notes: When = star_last. About half of all moves, because a Star holds one whole tier

Name: Rising
Description: Every player in the move is stronger than the one before. It builds all the way.
Notes: When = rising_power. Fires about one move in five and cannot easily be arranged - the tiers overlap - which is why it is the big one

Name: Borrowed Boots
Description: Nobody in this move shares a club. A scratch side's whole way of playing.
Notes: When = all_different_class. Your own side is one class so this never fires for you - it is the opposition's combo, and what a cobbled-together side gets for being cobbled together
